title: A distinctive meaning makes a sentence memorable
authors: Thomas Hikaru Clark, Greta Tuckute, Bryan Medina, Evelina Fedorenko
caption_short: Schematic of the sentence repeat-detection task: six-word sentences appear one at a time and the participant presses a key when a sentence repeats.
notes: Drawn by us: the journal article is closed access (ScienceDirect returned 403; OpenAlex lists no open copy) and no preprint was found, so its figures could not be checked or used. Task description from MIT News (2025-10-01) and from Clark et al., arXiv 2603.12105 (section 2.1). The three example sentences are printed in arXiv 2603.12105, Table 1 (one also in the MIT News article); the repeat shown is illustrative. Presentation timing is not drawn because we could not verify it.
